verdict.rationale: Scribe's documented Live mode streams binary PCM16 or Opus audio over a WebSocket and returns partial Captions and completed transcript items as speech is processed. The API reference includes an operation to open the Live Scribe WebSocket, and live sessions accept session.update events mid-stream. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time latency and behavior, and general availability of partial results (still in preview).

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: Stream audio over WebSocket and receive Captions (partial results) and completed transcript items as speech is detected and processed.
Binary PCM16 or Opus audio streaming
During a Live session, send another session.update event to replace the active inline vocabulary for subsequent recognition.
